title: IMAGE reference graph, pixel-size wire ambiguity, and ACIS peer readiness
mode: deeper/broader documentation and source research; plan update only
scope: Cross-check PAR-59 IMAGE/IMAGEDEF/IMAGEDEF_REACTOR relationships against current Autodesk DXF tables
Compare IMAGEDEF pixel-size group-code projections in current independent DXF implementation source
Refresh image dictionary, clipping-boundary, and U/V consumer risks from current peer reports
Refresh the ACIS writer and semantic-evidence boundary without promoting peer claims

evidence.source: Autodesk AutoCAD DXF IMAGE, IMAGEDEF, IMAGEDEF_REACTOR, and common object group-code references
observations: IMAGE group 340 references IMAGEDEF and 360 references IMAGEDEF_REACTOR.
IMAGEDEF persistent reactors include the ACAD_IMAGE_DICT pointer and a reactor pointer per image instance; IMAGEDEF_REACTOR group 330 identifies the associated IMAGE.
The IMAGE reference documents the full-image rectangular clip boundary as two opposite pixel-space corners when unclipped.
The IMAGEDEF table documents pixel-size values with groups 11 and 12.
evidence.limits: The documentation does not by itself validate this repository's emitted graph or resolve the conflict with the independent ezdxf 2D-point model.

evidence.source: ezdxf IMAGE/IMAGEDEF documentation and current image.py source
observations: Multiple IMAGE entities can share one IMAGEDEF and the referenced image file remains external to DXF.
The source creates one IMAGEDEF_REACTOR per IMAGE and models pixel_size as a 2D point based at code 11 (11/21 projection).
The source defines a default full-image boundary and maps boundary coordinates through each IMAGE's U/V vectors for WCS bounds.
evidence.limits: Current master is mutable and belongs to one DXF implementation lineage; it is not normative specification evidence or an independent native acceptance result.

evidence.source: Local libdxfrw IMAGEDEF parser and writer audit
observations: parseCode maps group 12 and group 21 to the same vp member; if both appear, later input wins.
writeObjects currently emits vp as group 21.
This local path is ambiguous relative to the Autodesk 11/12 table and ezdxf's point-code 11/21 model.
evidence.limits: Static source comparison only; no local writer output, peer parser, or native application was executed during this research.

observations: #1125 is merged and its stated fix changes early return to continue while skipping an ACAD_MATERIAL dictionary.
#1219 is open and reports empty IMAGE clip boundaries being written as count zero; its contributor reports AutoCAD's whole-image rectangle and an AutoCAD 2027 check.
#1249 is open and reports that image bounds require the image's U/V vectors and pixel-space boundary rather than adding raw pixel coordinates to insertion.
evidence.limits: The two open PRs are not merged/deployed, and their consumer results were not independently reproduced. They are test-design leads only.

evidence.source: ACadSharp #1195/#1240, ezdxf ACIS tools guide, and LibreDWG #1411
observations: ACadSharp #1195 reports silent omission of ACIS-bearing entities on its DXF write route; #1240 is open and not a released writer result.
ezdxf describes its ACIS tools as limited to simple known structures without an ACIS kernel.
LibreDWG #1411 remains an AcDs/modern SAB preservation lead.
evidence.limits: These are distinct source/project routes and do not establish libdxfrw defects or independent arbitrary-solid semantics.

readinessChanges: Add an isolated absent/12-only/21-only/both IMAGEDEF pixel-size wire discriminator with ASCII/Binary following-field sentinels before changing emitted tags.
Expand generated PAR-59 graph assertions to root NOD -> ACAD_IMAGE_DICT -> IMAGEDEF, IMAGE 340/360 edges, IMAGEDEF reactor-list links, and reactor-to-IMAGE back-links.
Add dictionary sibling-order cases to catch early termination and assert parsed handles instead of literal string presence.
Use the Autodesk-defined full-image rectangle for an unclipped IMAGE positive control; keep U/V transformed bounds in the optional composed consumer gate.
Keep open ACadSharp branches and simple ezdxf ACIS authoring explicitly non-promoting.
planImpact.nextAction: Continue 7P.5b identity planning and transactional graph output; resolve the IMAGEDEF 12-versus-21 wire projection as a separate fast subtask without blocking graph work.
